name: construct

# One real construction task per run, in four separate permission zones.
#   worker    the only job that sees the model key. Read-only token. Produces a patch, nothing else.
#   candidate applies the patch, pushes a candidate branch, starts the real Android CI on it. No model key.
#   verify    runs the story's own acceptance command (from .ralph/prd.json) against that CI run. Read-only. No model key.
#   promote   only after verify passes: marks the story, opens a pull request. Never touches main.
# Nothing here retries by itself and nothing here waits for a model to come back.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      story:
        description: "Story id from .ralph/prd.json. Empty = the open story with the lowest priority number."
        required: false
        default: ""
      note:
        description: "Optional extra instruction for the worker, for example the failure evidence of the last run."
        required: false
        default: ""
      publish:
        description: "false = stop after the worker and only keep its patch (a cheap first look). true = the full run."
        type: boolean
        default: true

concurrency:
  group: construct
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    outputs:
      story: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.story }}
      title: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.title }}
      red: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.red }}
      base: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Pick the story and build the work base
        id: pick
        env:
          IN_STORY: ${{ inputs.story }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ID="$IN_STORY"
          if [ -z "$ID" ]; then
            ID=$(jq -r '[.userStories[] | select(.passes != true)] | sort_by(.priority) | .[0].id // empty' .ralph/prd.json)
          fi
          [ -n "$ID" ] || { echo "No open story in .ralph/prd.json"; exit 1; }
          jq -e --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id)' .ralph/prd.json > /dev/null || { echo "Unknown story $ID"; exit 1; }
          [ "$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .passes' .ralph/prd.json)" != "true" ] || { echo "Story $ID is already closed"; exit 1; }
          TITLE=$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .title' .ralph/prd.json)
          RED=$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .verifyCommand' .ralph/prd.json | grep -oE 'refs/heads/audit/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+' | sed 's#^refs/heads/##' | sort -u | head -1 || true)
          BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          if [ -n "$RED" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/$RED:refs/remotes/origin/$RED"
            git merge --no-ff -m "construct: red tests ($RED) under the green work" "origin/$RED"
          fi
          {
            echo "story=$ID"
            echo "title=$TITLE"
            echo "red=$RED"
            echo "base=$BASE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          jq --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | del(.notes)' .ralph/prd.json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/story.json"
          echo "Story $ID: $TITLE (red branch: ${RED:-none})" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Write the construction contract
        env:
          IN_NOTE: ${{ inputs.note }}
          RED: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.red }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .construct
          echo ".construct/" >> .git/info/exclude
          cat > .construct/prompt.md <<'EOF'
          You are the construction worker for the Friday project. Read AGENTS.md first, then .ralph/VISION.md.
          Build exactly ONE story in this checkout: the story below, nothing else.

          How this run is organised (this differs from .ralph/prompt.md, which was written for the old phone loop):
          - You only edit files in the working tree. Do NOT run git commit, git push or git checkout, and do not create branches.
          - You have no network and must not run Gradle. CI builds and tests the result after you finish (see AGENTS.md).
          - Do NOT edit .github/**, .ralph/prd.json, .ralph/ci_verify.sh, .ralph/ralph.sh or .ralph/cloud/**. The run fails if you do.
          - Do not mark the story as passing. A separate job does that after CI and the story's own acceptance command pass.
          - From .ralph/prompt.md use only the discipline sections: plan first; grep the real sources before every import and
            record fixes in .ralph/SYMBOL_FACTS.md; systematic debugging. Ignore its steps about committing, branches, prd.json and progress.txt.
          - If the story has a RED-first criterion and a red branch is named below, that criterion is already done: its test files are in
            the tree and must stay byte-identical. Build the remaining criteria only.
          - Create the files the acceptance criteria name, at the paths they name. Put the mechanisms-considered notes in the incident file
            under a heading "Mechanisms considered".

          Finish with a final message of at most 30 lines: the files you changed, how each acceptance criterion is met or why it is not,
          and what remains unproven. Do not claim anything works: CI decides.
          EOF
          {
            echo
            echo "## Story (from .ralph/prd.json)"
            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/story.json"
            echo
            echo "## Red branch already merged under this work: ${RED:-none}"
            if [ -n "$IN_NOTE" ]; then
              echo
              echo "## Extra instruction from the operator"
              printf '%s\n' "$IN_NOTE"
            fi
          } >> .construct/prompt.md

      - name: Run Codex
        id: codex
        uses: openai/codex-action@v1
        timeout-minutes: 50
        with:
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          permission-profile: ":workspace"
          prompt-file: .construct/prompt.md
          output-file: .construct/final-message.md
          model: ${{ vars.CODEX_MODEL }}
          effort: ${{ vars.CODEX_EFFORT }}

      - name: Capture the candidate patch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git add -A
          mkdir -p cand
          git diff --cached --binary > cand/candidate.patch
          [ -s cand/candidate.patch ] || { echo "Codex changed nothing, so there is nothing to verify"; exit 1; }
          cp .construct/final-message.md cand/final-message.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no final message)" > cand/final-message.md
          {
            echo "### Worker finished"
            git diff --cached --stat | tail -40
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Keep the patch
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand/
          if-no-files-found: error

  candidate:
    needs: worker
    if: ${{ inputs.publish }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.push.outputs.branch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the exact base the worker used
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.base }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch the patch
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand

      - name: Build the candidate branch, push it and start the real CI on it
        id: push
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          RED: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.red }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          BR="candidate/${STORY}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git checkout -q -b "$BR"
          if [ -n "$RED" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/$RED:refs/remotes/origin/$RED"
            git merge --no-ff -m "construct: red tests ($RED) under the green work" "origin/$RED"
          fi
          git apply --index cand/candidate.patch
          BAD=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(\.github/|\.ralph/(ci_verify\.sh|prd\.json|ralph\.sh|cloud/))' || true)
          if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then
            echo "The worker changed protected files, so this candidate is refused:"
            echo "$BAD"
            exit 1
          fi
          git commit -q -m "construct: ${STORY} (candidate, not yet verified)"
          git push origin "$BR"
          echo "branch=$BR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          gh workflow run build.yml --ref "$BR"
          N=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
            N=$(gh run list --workflow build.yml --branch "$BR" --json headSha --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"$SHA\")] | length")
            [ "$N" -ge 1 ] && break
            sleep 10
          done
          [ "$N" -ge 1 ] || { echo "The CI run for $BR did not start within 6 minutes"; exit 1; }
          echo "Candidate branch $BR at ${SHA:0:10}; the real Android CI is running on it." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  verify:
    needs: [worker, candidate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 100
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run the story's own acceptance command
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          BR: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          BASE: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          set +e
          git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/audit/*:refs/heads/audit/*' || true
          git checkout -q -B "$BR" "origin/$BR"
          git show "$BASE:.ralph/prd.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/base_prd.json"
          CMD=$(jq -r --arg id "$STORY" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .verifyCommand' "$RUNNER_TEMP/base_prd.json")
          if [ -z "$CMD" ] || [ "$CMD" = "null" ]; then echo "No verifyCommand for $STORY"; exit 1; fi
          sudo mkdir -p /sdcard
          sudo ln -sfn "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" /sdcard/jarvis-repo
          export CIV_BRANCH="$BR" CIV_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600
          bash -c "$CMD" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
          RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          {
            echo "### Acceptance command for $STORY: exit $RC"
            echo '```'
            tail -60 "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit "$RC"

  promote:
    needs: [worker, candidate, verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the verified candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch the worker's message
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand

      - name: Mark the story and open the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          TITLE: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.title }}
          BR: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          sid = os.environ["STORY"]
          t = open(".ralph/prd.json", encoding="utf-8").read()
          i = t.index('"id": "%s"' % sid)
          j = t.index('"passes": false', i)
          k = t.find('"id":', i + 1)
          assert k == -1 or j < k, "passes flag not found inside the story"
          t = t[:j] + '"passes": true' + t[j + len('"passes": false'):]
          open(".ralph/prd.json", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
          PY
          jq -e --arg id "$STORY" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .passes == true' .ralph/prd.json > /dev/null
          echo "$(date -u +%F): $STORY verified by construct run $GITHUB_RUN_ID on candidate $BR (CI green, acceptance command passed)." >> .ralph/progress.txt
          git add .ralph/prd.json .ralph/progress.txt
          git commit -q -m "construct: $STORY verified (CI green, acceptance command passed)"
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$BR"
          CI_URL=$(gh run list --workflow build.yml --branch "$BR" --limit 1 --json url --jq '.[0].url')
          {
            echo "Verified candidate for story $STORY."
            echo
            echo "- CI run with the debug APK artifact: $CI_URL"
            echo "- The story's own acceptance command passed against that run."
            echo "- Not proven by any of this: behaviour on a real phone. Install the APK and test before you trust it."
            echo
            echo "Worker's final message (unverified claims, for reading only):"
            echo
            head -c 6000 cand/final-message.md
          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr.md"
          if gh pr create --base main --head "$BR" --title "$STORY: $TITLE" --body-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr.md"; then
            echo "Pull request opened for $BR. Merge it when you accept the change." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "Verified. Pull requests from Actions are not allowed on this repo yet, so open it yourself: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/compare/main...$BR?expand=1" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Lane census for the construct workflow.
For every provider whose API key is in the environment: read its LIVE model list, pick coding-capable candidates,
probe each with one streamed tool-call request, print what really came back (HTTP code, time, short body), and write
the models that answered into the opencode config. Exit 0 if a lane answered, 2 if none did, 3 if no key is set."""
import argparse, json, os, re, sys, time
import urllib.error, urllib.request

PROVIDERS = [
    dict(id="nvnim", name="NVIDIA NIM", env="NVIDIA_API_KEY", base="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
         prefer=[r"qwen3[-.]?coder", r"kimi[-.]?k2", r"devstral", r"deepseek[-.]?v[34]", r"glm", r"minimax",
                 r"gpt-oss-120b", r"qwen3.*(235|480)", r"mistral-(large|medium)", r"llama-3\.3-70b",
                 r"llama-3\.1-405b", r"nemotron.*(ultra|super)"], per=2, cap=10),
    dict(id="mistral", name="Mistral", env="MISTRAL_API_KEY", base="https://api.mistral.ai/v1",
         prefer=[r"devstral", r"codestral", r"mistral-large", r"mistral-medium"], per=2, cap=5),
    dict(id="groq", name="Groq", env="GROQ_API_KEY", base="https://api.groq.com/openai/v1",
         prefer=[r"qwen.*coder", r"kimi", r"gpt-oss-120b", r"qwen3", r"llama-3\.3-70b"], per=1, cap=5),
    dict(id="openrouter", name="OpenRouter", env="OPENROUTER_API_KEY", base="https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
         prefer=[r"qwen3-coder", r"kimi", r"glm", r"gpt-oss-120b", r"deepseek", r"devstral"], per=1, cap=6,
         require=r":free$"),
]

LONG_BAD = ("vision", "embed", "rerank", "reward", "guard", "safety", "retriev", "parse", "whisper", "audio",
            "image", "diffusion", "flux", "cosmos", "riva", "translat", "safeguard", "topic-control", "jailbreak",
            "moderat", "speech", "voice", "video", "vila", "neva", "paligemma", "fuyu", "kosmos", "ocr-")
SHORT_BAD = re.compile(r"(?:^|[^a-z0-9])(vl|vlm|asr|ocr|tts|clip|bge|e5|pii)(?:[^a-z0-9]|$)", re.I)

PROBE_TOOLS = [{"type": "function", "function": {
    "name": "ping", "description": "Call this function to confirm you can use tools.",
    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"note": {"type": "string"}}, "required": []}}}]


def vkey(s):
    return [(0, int(t), "") if t.isdigit() else (1, 0, t) for t in re.split(r"(\d+)", s) if t != ""]


def usable(mid):
    low = mid.lower()
    return not (any(w in low for w in LONG_BAD) or SHORT_BAD.search(low))


def pick_candidates(ids, spec):
    ids = [i for i in ids if usable(i)]
    if spec.get("require"):
        ids = [i for i in ids if re.search(spec["require"], i)]
    out = []
    for pat in spec["prefer"]:
        hit = sorted((i for i in ids if i not in out and re.search(pat, i, re.I)), key=vkey, reverse=True)
        out += hit[: spec.get("per", 2)]
    if not out:
        out = sorted(ids, key=vkey, reverse=True)[:3]
    return out[: spec.get("cap", 8)]


def clean(text, secrets, n=170):
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text or "").strip()
    for s in secrets:
        if s and len(s) > 6:
            text = text.replace(s, "[KEY]")
    text = re.sub(r"(nvapi-|sk-|csk-|gsk_|gh[pousr]_)[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{8,}", "[KEY]", text)
    return text[:n]


def http(method, url, key, body=None, timeout=45):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method, data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                 headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key, "Content-Type": "application/json",
                                          "Accept": "application/json" if body is None else "text/event-stream",
                                          "User-Agent": "cloud-ralph-census/1.2"})
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout)


def list_models(base, key, secrets):
    """returns (code, [(id, ctx)], note)"""
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        with http("GET", base.rstrip("/") + "/models", key, timeout=30) as r:
            j = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))
            rows = j.get("data") if isinstance(j, dict) else j
            out = []
            for m in rows or []:
                if not isinstance(m, dict) or not m.get("id"):
                    continue
                ctx = m.get("context_length") or m.get("context_window") or m.get("max_context_length") or m.get("max_model_len")
                out.append((m["id"], ctx if isinstance(ctx, int) else None))
            return r.status, out, "%.1fs" % (time.time() - t0)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, [], clean(e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), secrets)
    except Exception as e:  # timeout, dns, ssl, bad json
        return 0, [], clean("%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e), secrets)


def probe(base, key, model, secrets, timeout):
    """one streamed tool-call request. state: tool | text | empty | http | timeout | neterr"""
    body = {"model": model, "stream": True, "max_tokens": 256, "temperature": 0,
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Call the function ping now."}],
            "tools": PROBE_TOOLS, "tool_choice": "auto"}
    t0 = time.time()
    tool = text = False
    snippet = ""
    try:
        with http("POST", base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions", key, body, timeout=timeout) as r:
            code = r.status
            for raw in r:
                if time.time() - t0 > timeout:
                    return dict(state="timeout", code=code, secs=time.time() - t0, snippet="no end of stream in %ds" % timeout)
                line = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
                if not line.startswith("data:"):
                    continue
                data = line[5:].strip()
                if data == "[DONE]":
                    break
                try:
                    j = json.loads(data)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if isinstance(j, dict) and j.get("error"):
                    snippet = clean(json.dumps(j["error"]), secrets)
                for ch in (j.get("choices") or []) if isinstance(j, dict) else []:
                    d = ch.get("delta") or {}
                    if d.get("tool_calls"):
                        tool = True
                    if d.get("content") or d.get("reasoning_content") or d.get("reasoning"):
                        text = True
        state = "tool" if tool else ("text" if text else "empty")
        return dict(state=state, code=code, secs=time.time() - t0, snippet=snippet)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return dict(state="http", code=e.code, secs=time.time() - t0, snippet=clean(e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), secrets))
    except Exception as e:
        name = type(e).__name__
        st = "timeout" if "timeout" in name.lower() or "timed out" in str(e).lower() else "neterr"
        return dict(state=st, code=0, secs=time.time() - t0, snippet=clean("%s: %s" % (name, e), secrets))


def transient(code, state):
    return state in ("timeout", "neterr", "empty") or code == 429 or code >= 500 or code == 408 or code == 0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--config", help="opencode.json to merge the working providers into")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/tmp/lanes.json")
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("LANES_TIMEOUT", "60")))
    a = ap.parse_args()

    secrets = [os.environ.get(p["env"], "") for p in PROVIDERS]
    lanes, detail, kinds = [], [], []
    blocks = {}
    present = 0
    for p in PROVIDERS:
        key = os.environ.get(p["env"], "").strip()
        base = os.environ.get("LANES_BASE_" + p["id"].upper(), p["base"])
        if not key:
            continue
        present += 1
        print("census: %s: key present (%s), base %s" % (p["id"], p["env"], base))
        code, models, note = list_models(base, key, secrets)
        if code != 200 or not models:
            print("census: %s: model list FAILED http=%s %s" % (p["id"], code, note))
            kinds.append("transient" if transient(code, "http") else "hard")
            detail.append(dict(provider=p["id"], listed=0, code=code, note=note))
            continue
        ids = [m[0] for m in models]
        ctxof = dict(models)
        cands = pick_candidates(ids, p)
        print("census: %s: %d models listed (http=%s %s); testing %d: %s" % (p["id"], len(ids), code, note, len(cands), ", ".join(cands)))
        good, maybe = [], []
        for mid in cands:
            r = probe(base, key, mid, secrets, a.timeout)
            ok = r["state"] in ("tool", "text")
            word = {"tool": "answered with a tool call", "text": "answered with text only (tool use unconfirmed)",
                    "empty": "empty stream", "timeout": "TIMEOUT", "neterr": "NETWORK ERROR", "http": "FAILED"}[r["state"]]
            print("probe %s/%s: %s http=%s %.1fs%s" % (p["id"], mid, word, r["code"], r["secs"], (" | " + r["snippet"]) if r["snippet"] else ""))
            detail.append(dict(provider=p["id"], model=mid, **r))
            if r["state"] == "tool":
                good.append(mid)
            elif r["state"] == "text":
                maybe.append(mid)
            else:
                kinds.append("transient" if transient(r["code"], r["state"]) else "hard")
        use = good + maybe
        if use:
            models_cfg = {}
            for mid in use:
                ctx = ctxof.get(mid) or 131072
                models_cfg[mid] = {"name": mid, "tool_call": True, "limit": {"context": ctx, "output": min(16384, max(4096, ctx // 4))}}
            blocks[p["id"]] = {"npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible", "name": p["name"],
                               "options": {"baseURL": base, "apiKey": "{env:%s}" % p["env"], "timeout": 900000, "chunkTimeout": 300000},
                               "models": models_cfg}
            lanes += ["%s/%s" % (p["id"], m) for m in use]

    if present == 0:
        state = "nokeys"
    elif lanes:
        state = "ok"
    else:
        state = "transient" if "transient" in kinds else "hard"
    print("census: result %s; lanes: %s" % (state, " ".join(lanes) if lanes else "none"))

    if a.config and blocks:
        try:
            cfg = json.load(open(a.config)) if os.path.exists(a.config) else {}
        except ValueError:
            cfg = {}
        cfg.setdefault("$schema", "https://opencode.ai/config.json")
        cfg.setdefault("provider", {}).update(blocks)
        json.dump(cfg, open(a.config, "w"))
    json.dump(dict(state=state, lanes=lanes, detail=detail), open(a.out, "w"))
    sys.exit(0 if lanes else (3 if present == 0 else 2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: construct

# One real construction task per run, in four separate permission zones.
#   worker    the only job that sees a model key. Read-only token. Tests the free model lanes with real calls, then
#             runs one agent on the first lane that answers. Produces a patch, nothing else.
#   candidate applies the patch, pushes a candidate branch, starts the real Android CI on it. No model key.
#   verify    runs the story's own acceptance command (from .ralph/prd.json) against that CI run. Read-only. No model key.
#   promote   only after verify passes: marks the story, opens a pull request. Never touches main.
# Nothing here retries by itself. If no model lane answers, the run ends red within minutes and says why.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      story:
        description: "Story id from .ralph/prd.json. Empty = the open story with the lowest priority number."
        required: false
        default: ""
      note:
        description: "Optional extra instruction for the worker, for example the failure evidence of the last run."
        required: false
        default: ""
      publish:
        description: "false = stop after the worker and only keep its patch (a cheap first look). true = the full run."
        type: boolean
        default: true

concurrency:
  group: construct
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    outputs:
      story: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.story }}
      title: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.title }}
      red: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.red }}
      base: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Pick the story and build the work base
        id: pick
        env:
          IN_STORY: ${{ inputs.story }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ID="$IN_STORY"
          if [ -z "$ID" ]; then
            ID=$(jq -r '[.userStories[] | select(.passes != true)] | sort_by(.priority) | .[0].id // empty' .ralph/prd.json)
          fi
          [ -n "$ID" ] || { echo "No open story in .ralph/prd.json"; exit 1; }
          jq -e --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id)' .ralph/prd.json > /dev/null || { echo "Unknown story $ID"; exit 1; }
          [ "$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .passes' .ralph/prd.json)" != "true" ] || { echo "Story $ID is already closed"; exit 1; }
          TITLE=$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .title' .ralph/prd.json)
          RED=$(jq -r --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .verifyCommand' .ralph/prd.json | grep -oE 'refs/heads/audit/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+' | sed 's#^refs/heads/##' | sort -u | head -1 || true)
          BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          if [ -n "$RED" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/$RED:refs/remotes/origin/$RED"
            git merge --no-ff -m "construct: red tests ($RED) under the green work" "origin/$RED"
          fi
          echo "WORKHEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          {
            echo "story=$ID"
            echo "title=$TITLE"
            echo "red=$RED"
            echo "base=$BASE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          jq --arg id "$ID" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | del(.notes)' .ralph/prd.json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/story.json"
          echo "Story $ID: $TITLE (red branch: ${RED:-none})" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Write the construction contract
        env:
          IN_NOTE: ${{ inputs.note }}
          RED: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.red }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .construct
          echo ".construct/" >> .git/info/exclude
          cat > .construct/prompt.md <<'EOF'
          You are the construction worker for the Friday project. Read AGENTS.md first, then .ralph/VISION.md.
          Build exactly ONE story in this checkout: the story below, nothing else.

          How this run is organised (this differs from .ralph/prompt.md, which was written for the old phone loop):
          - You only edit files in the working tree. Do NOT run git commit, git push, git checkout or git reset, and do not create branches.
          - Do not use the network and do not run Gradle or any build. CI builds and tests the result after you finish (see AGENTS.md).
          - Do NOT edit .github/**, .ralph/prd.json, .ralph/ci_verify.sh, .ralph/ralph.sh or .ralph/cloud/**. The run fails if you do.
          - Do not mark the story as passing. A separate job does that after CI and the story's own acceptance command pass.
          - From .ralph/prompt.md use only the discipline sections: plan first; grep the real sources before every import and
            record fixes in .ralph/SYMBOL_FACTS.md; systematic debugging. Ignore its steps about committing, branches, prd.json and progress.txt.
          - If the story has a RED-first criterion and a red branch is named below, that criterion is already done: its test files are in
            the tree and must stay byte-identical. Build the remaining criteria only.
          - Create the files the acceptance criteria name, at the paths they name. Put the mechanisms-considered notes in the incident file
            under a heading "Mechanisms considered".

          Finish with a final message of at most 30 lines: the files you changed, how each acceptance criterion is met or why it is not,
          and what remains unproven. Do not claim anything works: CI decides.
          EOF
          {
            echo
            echo "## Story (from .ralph/prd.json)"
            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/story.json"
            echo
            echo "## Red branch already merged under this work: ${RED:-none}"
            if [ -n "$IN_NOTE" ]; then
              echo
              echo "## Extra instruction from the operator"
              printf '%s\n' "$IN_NOTE"
            fi
          } >> .construct/prompt.md

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Install the coding agent
        run: npm install -g opencode-ai@1.19.5

      - name: Find a model lane that answers (real calls, no waiting)
        id: lane
        env:
          NVIDIA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NVIDIA_API_KEY }}
          MISTRAL_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MISTRAL_API_KEY }}
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE: "true"
          OPENCODE_PERMISSION: '{"external_directory":{"*":"allow"}}'
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          set +e
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/opencode"
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          echo '{"$schema":"https://opencode.ai/config.json","agent":{"title":{"disable":true}},"provider":{"opencode":{"options":{"timeout":900000,"chunkTimeout":300000}}}}' > "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
          python3 .github/construct/lanes.py --config "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/lanes.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/census.txt" 2>&1
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/census.txt"
          KEYED=$(jq -r '.lanes | join(" ")' "$RUNNER_TEMP/lanes.json" 2>/dev/null)
          timeout 90 opencode models < /dev/null > "$RUNNER_TEMP/models.txt" 2>&1
          FREE=$(grep -E '^opencode/(big-pickle|.*-free)$' "$RUNNER_TEMP/models.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')
          gate_error() {
            GE=$(cat "$1"/*.log 2>/dev/null | grep 'message="stream error"' | grep -v 'agent=title')
            [ -n "$GE" ] || return 0
            GN=$(echo "$GE" | wc -l)
            G1=$(echo "$GE" | head -1 | grep -o 'error.error=.*' | cut -c1-200)
            if [ "$GN" -ge 2 ] || echo "$G1" | grep -qiE "free usage|quota|unauthor|forbidden|invalid|not found|insufficient|payment|credit"; then echo "$G1"; fi
          }
          gate() {
            GO=$(mktemp); GD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$GD/data" "$GD/work"; S0=$(date +%s); ERR=""
            ( cd "$GD/work" && exec env XDG_DATA_HOME="$GD/data" timeout -k 5 150 opencode run -m "$1" "Create a file named gate_tool.txt in the current directory containing exactly the word ok, then reply with the single word done." ) > "$GO" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
            GP=$!
            while kill -0 "$GP" 2>/dev/null; do
              sleep 3
              ERR=$(gate_error "$GD/data/opencode/log")
              if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then kill -TERM "$GP" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; kill -KILL "$GP" 2>/dev/null; break; fi
            done
            wait "$GP" 2>/dev/null; RC=$?
            if [ -z "$ERR" ] && [ "$RC" = 0 ] && [ -f "$GD/work/gate_tool.txt" ] && [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$GD/work/gate_tool.txt")" = ok ]; then
              echo "lane ok: $1 ($(( $(date +%s) - S0 ))s, used a tool)"; rm -rf "$GO" "$GD"; return 0
            fi
            [ -n "$ERR" ] || ERR="$(tail -3 "$GO" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-200)"
            [ -f "$GD/work/gate_tool.txt" ] || ERR="no tool call happened. $ERR"
            echo "lane failed: $1 rc=$RC after $(( $(date +%s) - S0 ))s: $ERR"; rm -rf "$GO" "$GD"; return 1
          }
          LANE=""
          for m in $KEYED $FREE; do
            OUT=$(gate "$m"); GRC=$?
            echo "$OUT"
            echo "$OUT" >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/census.txt"
            if [ "$GRC" = 0 ]; then LANE="$m"; break; fi
          done
          {
            echo "### Model lanes"
            echo '```'
            cut -c1-300 "$RUNNER_TEMP/census.txt" | tail -60
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -z "$LANE" ]; then
            echo "No model lane answered. Nothing was built and nothing will wait. The table above says why; try again later."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "lane=$LANE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Using lane: $LANE" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Run the worker agent
        timeout-minutes: 55
        env:
          LANE: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.lane }}
          NVIDIA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NVIDIA_API_KEY }}
          MISTRAL_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MISTRAL_API_KEY }}
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE: "true"
          OPENCODE_PERMISSION: '{"external_directory":{"*":"allow"}}'
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          set +e
          timeout -k 30 50m opencode run -m "$LANE" "$(cat .construct/prompt.md)" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null
          RC=$?
          tail -n 80 "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent.log"
          echo "The agent stopped with exit code $RC" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit 0

      - name: Capture the candidate patch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git add -A
          mkdir -p cand
          git diff --cached --binary "$WORKHEAD" > cand/candidate.patch
          [ -s cand/candidate.patch ] || { echo "The worker changed nothing, so there is nothing to verify"; exit 1; }
          tail -n 60 "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent.log" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' > cand/final-message.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no agent log)" > cand/final-message.md
          {
            echo "### Worker finished"
            git diff --cached --stat "$WORKHEAD" | tail -40
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Keep the patch
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand/
          if-no-files-found: error

  candidate:
    needs: worker
    if: ${{ inputs.publish }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.push.outputs.branch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the exact base the worker used
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.base }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch the patch
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand

      - name: Build the candidate branch, push it and start the real CI on it
        id: push
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          RED: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.red }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          BR="candidate/${STORY}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git checkout -q -b "$BR"
          if [ -n "$RED" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/$RED:refs/remotes/origin/$RED"
            git merge --no-ff -m "construct: red tests ($RED) under the green work" "origin/$RED"
          fi
          git apply --index cand/candidate.patch
          BAD=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(\.github/|\.ralph/(ci_verify\.sh|prd\.json|ralph\.sh|cloud/))' || true)
          if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then
            echo "The worker changed protected files, so this candidate is refused:"
            echo "$BAD"
            exit 1
          fi
          git commit -q -m "construct: ${STORY} (candidate, not yet verified)"
          git push origin "$BR"
          echo "branch=$BR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          gh workflow run build.yml --ref "$BR"
          N=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
            N=$(gh run list --workflow build.yml --branch "$BR" --json headSha --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"$SHA\")] | length")
            [ "$N" -ge 1 ] && break
            sleep 10
          done
          [ "$N" -ge 1 ] || { echo "The CI run for $BR did not start within 6 minutes"; exit 1; }
          echo "Candidate branch $BR at ${SHA:0:10}; the real Android CI is running on it." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  verify:
    needs: [worker, candidate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 100
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run the story's own acceptance command
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          BR: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          BASE: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          set +e
          git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/audit/*:refs/heads/audit/*' || true
          git checkout -q -B "$BR" "origin/$BR"
          git show "$BASE:.ralph/prd.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/base_prd.json"
          CMD=$(jq -r --arg id "$STORY" '.userStories[] | select(.id == $id) | .verifyCommand' "$RUNNER_TEMP/base_prd.json")
          if [ -z "$CMD" ] || [ "$CMD" = "null" ]; then echo "No verifyCommand for $STORY"; exit 1; fi
          sudo mkdir -p /sdcard
          sudo ln -sfn "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" /sdcard/jarvis-repo
          export CIV_BRANCH="$BR" CIV_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600
          bash -c "$CMD" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
          RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          {
            echo "### Acceptance command for $STORY: exit $RC"
            echo '```'
            tail -60 "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit "$RC"

  promote:
    needs: [worker, candidate, verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the verified candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch the worker's message
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate
          path: cand

      - name: Mark the story and open the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STORY: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.story }}
          TITLE: ${{ needs.worker.outputs.title }}
          BR: ${{ needs.candidate.outputs.branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "friday-construct"
          git config user.email "friday-construct@users.noreply.github.com"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          sid = os.environ["STORY"]
          t = open(".ralph/prd.json", encoding="utf-8").read()

Short answer: GPT and I agree on the architecture. We disagree on the order, and the order is what burned the eight months. Its plan builds a cockpit before any worker has landed a story.
What I checked in its plan
What holds up:

Codespaces is free for your account. Personal accounts get 120 compute hours and 15 GB a month, and usage is blocked, not billed, when the quota runs out with no card on file. The default idle stop is 30 minutes.
Orca is real, and its Android app pairs with a headless server.
Antigravity's CLI has a documented headless mode and a remote sign-in flow.

What doesn't hold up:

The "existing Python Builder" isn't in your repo. I checked the real checkout. The old test imports a package that doesn't exist, and the in-app builder is unwired. Your builder today is Ralph plus CI. If the Python one lives somewhere else, show me.
It doesn't fix the real bottleneck, free inference. Codespaces only changes where the agent runs. Antigravity's free tier is refreshed weekly, has been cut repeatedly, and agent tasks stop mid-run when the allowance empties. I couldn't confirm Egypt is covered.
The cockpit is heavy and unproven. Orca's remote server is beta upstream. Its headless mode needs a virtual display and terminal setup. That means commands again and three new parts, with no worker proven.

Our moves, in order:
